Figure 1: Overview of MERIT’s causal online repair process. A frozen LLM produces a shared initial SQL prediction. After an unsuccessful attempt, MERIT classifies the observed failure, retrieves experience from earlier finalized episodes, and generates one revision. A benchmark correctness oracle controls termination and memory polarity without exposing the reference SQL or result rows to the model. Current-query attempts remain local, and each finalized episode contributes at most one memory entry that becomes visible only to later queries.
